usedFor: Copper holds opportunities and companies, and Google Sheets keeps a row for each through “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Opportunity” in Copper, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: It keeps one row per deal current as an opportunity changes, instead of piling up copies.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes an existing row, so the sheet needs a row for the opportunity first.
